children.code:
<linear-gradient()> = 
  linear-gradient( [ <linear-gradient-syntax> ] )  

<linear-gradient-syntax> = 
  [ <angle> | <zero> | to <side-or-corner> ]? , <color-stop-list>  

<side-or-corner> = 
  [ left | right ]  ||
  [ top | bottom ]  

<color-stop-list> = 
  <linear-color-stop> , [ <linear-color-hint>? , <linear-color-stop> ]#?

<linear-color-stop> = 
  <color> <length-percentage>?  

<linear-color-hint> = 
  <length-percentage>  

<length-percentage> = 
  <length>      |
  <percentage>
